label: SSBP2::CSF1R

sections.text: SSBP2 encodes a protein that stabilizes transcriptional regulatory complexes in hematopoietic cells.
CSF1R encodes the colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor tyrosine kinase.
The fusion retains the carboxy-terminal kinase domain and creates constitutive growth signaling. SSBP2::CSF1R is an ABL-class kinase lesion in Ph-like B-ALL.
ABL-class kinase inhibition has a biological and preclinical rationale in this fusion class; treatment of Ph-like ALL with these agents is distinct from the BCR::ABL1-positive ALL drug indications.
